title: VUA inspection.requestRun (v0.1)
description: Write-command face of the M7 inspection slice (proposal 016, hard precondition 2): the tasked command that drives the five Bridge producing operations (v1 validate_avatar and analyze_performance typed checks, v3 read-only inspection operations inspect_avatar_references / inspect_lighting / inspect_upload_readiness) and publishes exactly one inspection-evidence document per run under a fresh AMF-generated uuid-v7 inspectionId. FROZEN v0.1 (core implementation batch 2026-09-13, same inspection-queries family as the data-role get/list row; freeze batch 2026-09-13, data role): the freeze hard-preconditions are closed — the implementation batch landed and accepted (merge 7a262b8) followed by the data-review revision batch (c914cf2: family-owned INSPECTION_QUERIES_SCHEMA_VERSION="0.1" unifies the three family replies, the result const and the example; avatarRef.ref maxLength dropped so the verbatim carry matches the evidence body shape — ratified by the data role); positive/negative vectors green plus consumer tests in-tree (provider-host frame loop + acquisition inspection_queries_contract); the bilingual protocol document and the docs/REGISTRY.md row land with this freeze batch. The acceptance reply follows the tasked-command face (job.execute precedent): the caller polls the application task face by taskId; the task result payload carries the inspectionId and the aggregated overallStatus. avatarRef is the verbatim identity of the inspected avatar (namespaced identity or explicit scene path, never a guess); avatarGlobalObjectId is the Unity scene target the producing operations inspect. Params are a closed two-key set; paths are provider-bound configuration and never travel the wire (M3/T1 ruling).

avatarGlobalObjectId.description: The Unity scene object identity the inspection operations target (payload of every producing command, closed single payload shape per the 016 operation-shape proposal).

avatarRef.description: Verbatim identity of the inspected avatar, carried into the evidence body unchanged (ref required; label is the observed display name when one exists, never invented).

inspection-requestRunResult.description: Tasked-command acceptance (job.execute reply shape): poll the application task face by taskId; do not poll this method again.
